components.name: Page Name
components.description: Sets the browser tab title and, if the UI is not minimalist, sets the title in the top bar. Defaults to MMGIS

components.name: Theme
components.description: The USWDS theme to apply to the modern interface.

components.name: Map Logo Image URL
components.description: URL path to a logo image to display on the map. Supports: (1) Absolute URLs (e.g., 'https://example.com/logo.png'), (2) Mission-relative paths (e.g., 'logo.png' for Missions/[mission]/logo.png), (3) Public assets (e.g., 'public/images/logos/logo.png'). The logo will appear in the bottom-right corner of the map and will be included in screenshots.

components.name: Map Logo Size
components.description: Size of the map logo. Small: 64px, Medium: 128px, Large: 192px. Default is Medium.

components.name: Map Logo Link URL
components.description: Optional URL to navigate to when the logo is clicked (e.g., 'https://mission.nasa.gov').

components.name: Interface Mode
components.description: Interface mode for the mission. This is set during mission creation and cannot be changed.
components.disabledMessage: Interface mode is set during mission creation and cannot be changed.

components.name: Panel Layout Style
components.description: Determines if the panels are overlaid on top of the map or if they push the map to resize.

components.name: Panels
components.description: Configuration for the panels in the modern interface mode.

object.name: ID
object.description: Unique identifier for this panel (e.g., 'left-panel', 'top-panel').

object.name: Title
object.description: Display title for the panel (optional).

object.name: Position
object.description: Position of the panel: top, left, right, or bottom.

object.name: Priority
object.description: Layout priority (lower claims space first).

object.name: Layout Type
object.description: How tools are arranged in expanded state: stacked (all visible) or tabbed (only active tool visible).

object.name: Has Header
object.description: Whether panel has a header with title and control buttons.

object.name: Allowed States
object.description: Select permitted states for this panel. Options: collapsed (hidden), iconified (icons only), focused (single tool), expanded (all tools).

object.name: Default State
object.description: Initial state when panel is created. Must be one of the allowed states.

object.name: Supported Orientation
object.description: Tool orientation compatibility: horizontal (top/bottom), vertical (left/right), or any.

object.name: Resizable
object.description: Whether user can drag-resize the panel.

object.name: Max Tools
object.description: Maximum number of tools allowed in this panel (leave empty for no limit).

object.name: Min Size (px)
object.description: Minimum size in pixels when drag-resizing (requires resizable: true).

object.name: Max Size (px)
object.description: Maximum size in pixels. Caps drag-resizing and caps a content-sized panel (one with no Expanded Size) so overflow scrolls internally. Works with or without resizable. Leave empty for no cap.

object.name: Iconified Size
object.description: Size of the icon bar when iconified (width for left/right, height for top/bottom). Leave empty for the default 3.5rem. A plain number is pixels (e.g. 56); add a unit to use it instead (e.g. 3.5rem). The icons scale with the bar, so a smaller bar means smaller icons.

object.name: Expanded Size
object.description: Size when expanded (width for left/right, height for top/bottom). The panel is exactly this size and its content scrolls; leave empty to size to content. A plain number is pixels (e.g. 320); add a unit to use it instead (e.g. 40vh, 30%, 20rem).

object.name: Pinned Tools
object.description: Tool identifiers to hold in this panel's pinned region. They render above Panel Tools, in the order listed, and stay in place while the rest of the panel scrolls. Only left and right panels have a pinned region. Same identifiers as Panel Tools; a tool belongs to one list or the other.

object.name: Panel Tools
object.description: Tool identifiers to assign to this panel's scrolling body. Can be tool names (e.g., 'Title') or tool IDs (e.g., 'Title_instance1') for multiple instances. Must match values in the mission's tools array. Example: Title,Layers,Draw

components.name: Floating Panels
components.description: Panels that float over the center map area. Each floating panel is anchored to one of six positions. At most one panel per position is allowed.

object.name: ID
object.description: Unique identifier for this floating panel (e.g., 'timeline-panel', 'legend-float').

object.name: Position
object.description: Where the panel floats within the map area.

object.name: Title
object.description: Display title shown in the header (only relevant when Has Header is enabled).

object.name: Has Header
object.description: Whether the panel shows a title bar with control buttons.

object.name: Transparent
object.description: Draw no background, border or shadow for this panel or for the cards behind its tools, so the map shows through and tools that draw their own boxes (like Map Control) sit directly on it.

object.name: Allowed States
object.description: Permitted states for this panel. Floating panels support collapsed (hidden) and expanded (visible) only.

object.name: Default State
object.description: Initial visibility state when the panel is created.

object.name: Default Width
object.description: Initial width of each tool card. Accepts any CSS unit (e.g. '300px', '40%', '20vw'). Leave empty to size to content.

object.name: Default Height
object.description: Initial height of each tool card. Accepts any CSS unit (e.g. '200px', '30%', '25vh'). Leave empty to size to content.

object.name: Min Width
object.description: Minimum width of each tool card. Accepts any CSS unit (e.g. '100px', '10%').

object.name: Max Width
object.description: Maximum width of each tool card. Accepts any CSS unit (e.g. '600px', '50%').

object.name: Min Height
object.description: Minimum height of each tool card. Accepts any CSS unit (e.g. '100px', '10vh').

object.name: Max Height
object.description: Maximum height of each tool card. Accepts any CSS unit (e.g. '400px', '40%', '50vh'). Useful for preventing top/bottom float zones from overlapping.

object.name: Tools
object.description: Tool names to display in this floating panel. Each tool renders as its own card with a gap between cards. Must match tool names in the mission's tools array (e.g., 'Timeline', 'Legend').

components.name: Zoom Level of Map Scale
components.description: An integer to be the default map zoom level. This is not the initial zoom but rather a preferred zoom level that functions as a default if an ideal zoom for a function cannot be determined. Setting this value also adds a button above the scale bar to quickly zoom to it. In terms of drawing features, this is the preferred zoom level at which users should draw.

components.name: World Copy Jump
components.description: With this option enabled, the map tracks when you pan to another 'copy' of the world and seamlessly jumps to the original one so that all overlays like markers and vector layers are still visible.

components.name: Provider
components.description: Renders a vector-tile basemap beneath map layers using MapLibre or Mapbox GL. Works with both Leaflet and deck.gl engine missions. 'maplibre' is open-source and requires no token. 'mapbox' requires an access token.

components.name: Style URL
components.description: MapLibre or Mapbox style URL. Example: https://demotiles.maplibre.org/style.json or mapbox://styles/mapbox/streets-v12

components.name: Access Token
components.description: Mapbox GL access token. Required only when provider is set to 'mapbox'.

When these options are set, the map restricts the view to the given geographical bounds, bouncing the user back if the user tries to pan outside the view. Defaults to the full extent of the map's projection. All sides must be set to take effect. All 0 is considered off. Units are in decimal degrees and longitude is often [-180, 180].

components.name: 3D Globe Renderer
components.description: Select which 3D rendering engine to use for the Globe Panel. LithoSphere is the default renderer. CesiumJS offers improved performance and different visualization capabilities.

components.name: DEM Fallback URL
components.description: A URL to an underlying and ever-present DEM terrain tileset to fill in any missing elevation tiles of active layers.

components.name: Default Viewer Width (%)
components.description: Default percentage width for the Viewer panel (0-100). The sum of Viewer, Map, and Globe widths must equal 100. These defaults are overridden by URL deeplinks (panePercents parameter). Leave blank to use system default (0).

components.name: Default Map Width (%)
components.description: Default percentage width for the Map panel (0-100). The sum must equal 100. Overridden by deeplinks. Leave blank for default (100).

components.name: Default Globe Width (%)
components.description: Default percentage width for the Globe panel (0-100). The sum must equal 100. Overridden by deeplinks. Leave blank for default (0).

⚠️ Important: The three panel width percentages must sum to exactly 100. If they don't sum to 100, the system will fall back to the default layout (Viewer 0%, Map 100%, Globe 0%). Deeplinks with the 'panePercents' parameter will always override these configured defaults.

components.name: Primary Color
components.description: Colors various buttons, components, panels, feature hover text.

components.name: Secondary Color
components.description: Colors some panels and UI borders and is used as the background of the Viewer Panel.

components.name: Tertiary Color
components.description: Colors many icons and text.

components.name: Accent Color
components.description: Colors things like the active tool indicator.

components.name: Body Color
components.description: Colors the overall body but might have little impact.

components.name: TopBar Color
components.description: Colors the top horizontal bar.

components.name: ToolBar Color
components.description: Colors the left vertical toolbar

components.name: Map Color
components.description: Colors the background of the map. The color is seen in regions of the 2D map where there is no data.

components.name: Highlight Color
components.description: The color with which to highlight selected features in the map.

components.name: Copy Link
components.description: Allows users to click a button to generate a deep-link to the current state of their view of MMGIS.

components.name: Screenshot
components.description: Allows users to click a button to save a screenshot of the current 2D map.

components.name: Fullscreen
components.description: Allows users to enter and exit fullscreen mode.

components.name: User Info
components.description: Add a button to take users to a link that provides more information.

components.name: User Info URL Link
components.description: Required in order to enable button.

components.name: User Help
components.description: Add a button to take users to a link that provides custom help on how to use MMGIS.

components.name: User Help URL Link
components.description: Required in order to enable button.
